title: AssetRecord
description: One reusable asset the company owns: media, brand, content, screenshots. The registry POINTS to where it lives (`location` = repo path, Drive URL, or tool ref); it never copies the bytes. `asset_id` is the unique key; `repo`, when set, must exist in repos.jsonl.

location.description: where the asset actually lives: repo path, Drive/URL, or tool ref

repo.description: owning repo (owner/name) — must exist in repos.jsonl; null if not repo-bound

sku.description: linked SKU id, e.g. sku_001; null if none
